notes.title: The Next Fest started, and we are part of it!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114476/ac044f8ce38c892f8e96d0e4d9588f162641c35e.jpg[/img]

Thanks to Steam, [b]The Battle for Vega[/b] it's part of the currently running [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], and we are very grateful to be there! As part of the patch cycle a few adjustments were made to the demo version:
[list]
[*] [b]Leaderboards[/b]: Now the top 3 ranks will be shown on top of the list as a whole
[*] [b]Home[/b]: Added the control scheme in the home screen, as well as the ranking of your friends
[*] [b]Arcade[/b]: Even when a run it's not fully complete we still send score data to the leaderboards, and you can see your position right there
[*] [b]Gameplay[/b]: Thanks to a tester, and good friend of mine all of the flying enemies (the ones that leave the grid) will show a small positioning mark where they will return after the fly, this will make hunting for the last few flyers a bit easier to everybody!
[/list]
